title: Yerevan protest outside UN Armenia office
reason: The reported demand is directed at the UN and its international response, not Armenia’s government or policy.
notes: Shoghakat describes dozens of citizens, which does not establish 50 or more. CivilNet search-only result appears to cover the same protest; relation unverified. Attendance and any Armenian-state demand remain unknown.

title: Protest outside the US Embassy in Yerevan concerning Artsakh
reason: The source directs requests to US embassy representatives and asks the US to act and recognize Artsakh.
notes: Armenpress reports multiple citizens but no headcount. This is not evidence of a demand on Armenia’s own state.

title: Artsakh women protest outside UN Armenia office
reason: The stated addressees are the UN Armenia representative and international community.
notes: No attendance estimate is reported. Participants are described as women displaced from Artsakh; no own-Armenian-state demand is documented.

title: Demonstration outside the German embassy in Yerevan over Artsakh
reason: The rally sought action and recognition from Germany, a foreign state.
notes: Armenpress says some participants blocked part of a street, but reports no crowd size. That description does not establish the 50-person threshold or a demand on Armenia’s government.

title: Protest visits to Italian, Ukrainian, and Georgian embassies in Yerevan
reason: The reported demands ask foreign governments to condemn Azerbaijan and Turkey and address foreign-policy actions.
notes: Azatutyun published on 22 October and describes the Italian embassy gathering as its second day; 21 October is a direct inference for the preceding day. Attendee count is not given. The multi-mission route is retained as one reported action; no automatic merger with other embassy protests.

title: Artsakh women and children protest at the EU Delegation in Yerevan
reason: The source describes a request for an international response delivered to the EU Delegation, not a demand on Armenia’s government.
notes: Attendance is not quantified. The EU officer’s proposed handling of a letter is not coded as Armenian-state accommodation.

title: Los Angeles Armenian diaspora march concerning the Artsakh war
reason: The gathering took place in Los Angeles, outside Armenia, and addressed foreign audiences/authorities.
notes: Diaspora activity outside the assigned country is not imported into the Armenia event count. No crowd estimate from this report is transferred to any Armenia-based action.
